sentences.en: The court's jurisprudence in this area is based on the Equal Protection Clause of the 14th Amendment.

sentences.en: And in many contexts,

sentences.zh: 第14修正案的这一条款意味着你不能基于种族进行歧视，无论出于好意还是恶意。
